nm SPLIT A two-for-one stock split of the Class A Common Stock (stock dividend) was approved 2026-08-06, record date 2026-08-17, distributed 2026-09-02 and 'has now been effected' (8-K of 2026-09-04); IBKR lists the split with ex date 2026-09-03. The price here (IBKR last 74.31) and the saved universe price 80.3 of 2026-10-21 are POST-split (the unadjusted June 2026 high was about 178; IBKR's history is adjusted for both the 2024-06 and 2026-09 splits). EVERY per-share and share-count figure in SEC filings up to the 10-Q of 2026-07-31 (the prefetch pf_eps_diluted_*, pf_shares_diluted_wavg_*, the 10-Q cover 1,232,983,457 shares, guided Adjusted Diluted EPS of $1.40-$1.42 for Q3 2026) is on the PRE-2026-split basis: divide by 2 (FY2025 GAAP diluted EPS 3.34 = 1.67 post-split; FY2024 1.92 = 0.96; Q3 2026 guide 0.70-0.71). FY2021-FY2023 prefetch EPS are further pre the 2024-06 split (divide by 4 to reach today's basis; FY2024 and FY2025 by 2). Alpha Vantage's per-share consensus from the Q3 2026 row on is post-split (FY2026E 2.69, FY2027E 3.33); its older rows (Q2 2026 estimate 1.19, Q1 2026 0.95) are pre-split. Dividends: $0.25 a quarter before the split, $0.125 after (annual rate $0.50 = 0.67% of 74.31). The next 10-Q (Q3 2026) will be the first filing on the post-split basis.

nm RECONCILIATION H1 2026 one-offs that depress GAAP and are in the TTM GAAP net income used below: discrete tax items of $329.0M in H1 2026 (China tax determinations $130.0M + reassessment $160.0M in Q1, $39.0M foreign-tax reserves in Q2), acquisition-related expenses $272.4M pre-tax in H1 2026 (CommScope inventory step-up $132.0M, transaction and backlog amortization $140.4M). Q1 2026 GAAP net income 933.0 is therefore not a run rate (Adjusted H1 EPS 2.42 vs GAAP 2.10, pre-split); TTM GAAP EPS 1.99 post-split vs TTM Adjusted about 2.16 (0.93+0.97+1.07+1.35 = 4.32 pre-split, halved).

nm ROIC CHECK prefetch/forensic.json roic is 'unavailable' (the prefetch history carries no debt), so it was computed here from the 10-Q: invested capital = equity 15,491.6 + debt 18,811.3 + redeemable NCI 9.0 - cash 4,729.4 - short-term investments 689.7 = 28,892.8 at 2026-06-30, and 17,480.9 at 2025-12-31 (13,413.1 + 15,502.0 - 11,130.6 - 303.6; the year-end cash was held ahead of the CommScope purchase that closed in Q1 2026: acquisitions net of cash acquired were $10,684.0 in H1 2026). TTM NOPAT at a 25% tax rate = 7,841.4 x 0.75 = 5,881 on the average of the two = 25.4%; on the end-Q2 capital 20.4%; Q2 annualised (2,584.6 x 4 x 0.75 = 7,754) on end-Q2 capital 26.8% (26.0% excluding the $80M tariff recovery). Inputs not in the engine's formula: the 689.7 short-term investments are treated as cash-like; operating lease liabilities are NOT added to debt; no restricted cash line was found in the 10-Q; goodwill and intangibles are 22.8B of the 28.9B, so ROIC on tangible capital is far higher; the TTM figure understates because CommScope earned for only two of the four quarters while its full purchase price is in capital.
